notes:
## New

- Orphaned comments stay with their file — when the commented lines leave the diff but the file is still present, the thread appears in that file's card with an Orphaned tag, its last known location, and the captured code; the bucket at the top of the review now only holds comments whose file left the diff entirely
- Text in rendered markdown previews can be selected and copied
- Comment on brand-new markdown files from the preview — click any paragraph to jump to its line in the source diff, ready to comment

## Fixed

- Links in markdown previews and release notes open in your system browser instead of navigating the app window away — cmd-click and middle-click included

## Other

- Security hardening across the app, CLI, and release pipeline: the window is pinned to the app origin, comment text can no longer inject terminal escape sequences into CLI output, database reads are read-only, and review data is validated at every boundary

## New

- What's New — release notes for every version, in the Prologue menu and shown once automatically after an update

## New

- Viewed files expand automatically when you click them in the sidebar or jump to them with ⌘P

## New

- Rich markdown diffs — markdown files can be reviewed as a rendered preview with change markers instead of raw text

## Fixed

- The Install 'prologue' Command Line Tool action works again in packaged builds

## New

- Check for Updates… in the Prologue menu

## New

- The welcome screen shows the app version

The first release of Prologue — a macOS app for reviewing git diffs before they leave your machine.

- Review any branch, base, or working-tree diff with virtualized rendering, syntax highlighting, and word-level change highlights
- Leave inline comments and threaded replies anchored to diff lines; threads re-anchor as the code moves and archive with the review
- Generated review guides that walk the diff in a narrative order
- `prologue` CLI (bundled, installable from the app menu) for reading reviews and replying from the terminal or an agent
- Keyboard-first navigation: j/k, n/p, ⌘P file jump, and a ? shortcut cheat sheet
- Auto-updates via GitHub Releases
